messages.recipient_title: Vice President Corporate Communications and Public Affairs
messages.subject: For Marianne Stigset | Public Affairs, Sustainability & Industrial Transition | Executive Proposal
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Stigset,

I am writing from Guyana, where I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My role spans government relations, regulatory coordination, ESG, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive issue management in a major mining and industrial operation.

Elkem is an especially strong fit with my background because its business sits at the intersection of critical materials, renewable energy, industrial competitiveness, climate regulation and public policy. These are areas where external affairs and sustainability need to be tightly connected to operating decisions and executive strategy.

I prepared an Elkem-specific Strategic Value Creation Proposal rather than sending a conventional CV alone. It outlines where I would add value across public affairs, industrial-policy intelligence, sustainability governance, stakeholder strategy and responsible growth. My three-page Executive CV forms the final section.

I am open to relocation to Norway and employer-supported work authorization. My strongest fit would be a Director, Head or senior leadership mandate across Public Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, External Affairs, Strategic Partnerships or country and regional stakeholder leadership.

I would value a short confidential conversation. If another senior leader owns the most relevant mandate, I would be grateful if you would route the proposal internally.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposal: Public Affairs, Sustainability and Industrial Transition
strategic_brief.prepared_for_title: Vice President Corporate Communications and Public Affairs
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Elkem operates at the center of several strategic issues shaping European industry: critical materials, renewable power, industrial competitiveness, climate regulation, trade exposure and the transition toward lower-carbon production. These issues require close coordination between operating businesses, sustainability, public affairs and executive leadership. I bring director-level experience from a multinational mining operation where government relations, regulatory coordination, ESG, energy transition and stakeholder management are integrated into daily business decisions. My contribution would be to strengthen the connection between institutional intelligence, sustainability commitments and industrial execution, with particular value in regulated resource markets and emerging economies where government relationships and operating credibility materially affect growth.
strategic_brief.company_context: Elkem is headquartered in Oslo and holds leading positions in silicon, ferrosilicon, foundry alloys and carbon solutions. The company combines natural raw materials, renewable energy and industrial process technology while operating within an increasingly complex European regulatory and geopolitical environment. Recent developments include strategic restructuring, cost and competitiveness measures, EU emissions trading exposure and long-term renewable-power agreements. Elkem's current leadership structure includes dedicated Corporate Communications and Public Affairs responsibility, reflecting the importance of policy, reputation and institutional engagement to the business. A disciplined framework that links policy developments, regulatory exposures, stakeholder commitments and operating priorities can help leadership anticipate constraints, shape external engagement and protect long-term industrial competitiveness.

opportunities.title: Industrial-policy and regulatory intelligence
opportunities.rationale: Energy-intensive materials producers face evolving climate regulation, carbon pricing, trade measures, state support frameworks and energy-policy decisions. These issues can materially influence operating economics, investment choices and competitive positioning before they appear in conventional business reporting.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would build executive-level regulatory and policy intelligence that ranks external developments by business materiality, maps institutional stakeholders and links each issue to an accountable internal owner and strategic response.

opportunities.title: Government affairs tied to operating priorities
opportunities.rationale: Public affairs creates greater value when institutional engagement is directly connected to energy, permitting, investment, trade and industrial competitiveness priorities rather than managed as a separate communications activity.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would establish issue-based government engagement plans linking ministries, regulators and industry bodies to specific operating and strategic outcomes, with clear milestones and executive visibility.

opportunities.title: Sustainability evidence and commitment governance
opportunities.rationale: Elkem's climate and ESG positioning depends on defensible operating evidence, clear source ownership and disciplined follow-through across sites and functions. Regulatory and investor scrutiny makes governance of sustainability claims increasingly important.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would strengthen commitment registers, evidence ownership and review routines by applying experience from carbon-data governance, renewable-energy implementation and cross-functional ESG coordination in a regulated industrial environment.

opportunities.title: Resource-market and emerging-economy strategy
opportunities.rationale: Critical-material and industrial companies increasingly depend on international resource markets where government priorities, local-content expectations, infrastructure and stakeholder legitimacy shape commercial outcomes. Practical country intelligence improves both risk management and opportunity development.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would support selected international markets with government engagement, stakeholder mapping, regulatory coordination and country intelligence grounded in direct resource-sector operating experience.

days_0_30: Map priority public-policy, regulatory and stakeholder issues affecting selected businesses and markets.
Identify gaps between external commitments, internal ownership and executive visibility.
days_31_60: Introduce an executive issue register connecting policy developments to business impacts and response owners.
Build stakeholder maps for priority energy, climate, trade and industrial-policy workstreams.
days_61_90: Advance selected institutional priorities to measurable outcomes and strengthen evidence behind key sustainability narratives.
Deliver a concise dashboard covering regulatory exposure, stakeholder positions, commitments and management action.
days_91_180: Embed the operating rhythm across additional businesses or markets.
Measure results through issue resolution, stakeholder outcomes, assurance readiness and reduced regulatory surprises.

potential_impact: Earlier executive visibility of material policy and regulatory developments affecting industrial competitiveness.
Stronger government engagement tied directly to operating and investment priorities.
Improved sustainability evidence quality and accountability behind external commitments.
More disciplined country and stakeholder strategy across selected international resource markets.
background_relevance: Director-level responsibility across government relations, regulatory coordination, ESG, corporate affairs, social responsibility and executive advisory within a multinational mining company.
Senior engagement with mining, environmental, energy, labour, standards, taxation, trade and investment institutions, with responsibility for translating external expectations into internal action.
Experience with renewable-energy deployment, carbon-data governance and assurance-oriented evidence systems in a regulated industrial setting.
Practical operating exposure to resource-sector policy, local-content expectations, major-project stakeholder management and emerging-market institutional complexity.
